verdict.rationale: Cognee ships an official, documented MCP server (cognee-mcp) that connects to MCP-compatible AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, Cline, Continue, and Codex, and this was independently verified at runtime — a live stdio JSON-RPC handshake succeeded via uvx with the official pypi package. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) reports of using the MCP server in production workflows beyond the single probe test.
